header.title: Reports Center
header.subtitle: Pipeline health, sources, calling activity, funnel velocity and follow-up hygiene — one place.

filters.noInstitute: Pick an institute to view reports.

descriptions.overview: Leads received, how many converted, response speed and where they came from.
descriptions.funnel: How leads move from stage to stage and where they drop off.
descriptions.dispositions: What happened on each lead — call outcomes and statuses set by counsellors.
descriptions.followups: Open follow-ups right now, grouped by how overdue they are.
descriptions.sources: Leads, conversions and revenue for each source.
descriptions.utm: Website visits and enquiries by UTM campaign, source and medium.
descriptions.calling: Calls dialled, connected and talk time per counsellor and per day.
descriptions.leadCalls: Every lead with its last call, next callback and call count.
descriptions.callIntelligence: AI scores and coaching tips from recorded calls.
descriptions.activity: Notes, calls, status changes and follow-ups done by each counsellor.
descriptions.counsellors: Each counsellor's leads, conversions, response time and overdue work.
descriptions.conversions: Leads that enrolled into a course, by counsellor and campaign.
descriptions.manager: Team-level view for managers — workload and performance per counsellor.
descriptions.revenue: Payments received, by day, source and counsellor.
descriptions.admissions: Students admitted each month — fees, paid and due — by course, source and counsellor.
descriptions.cohort: Leads grouped by the month they came in, and how many converted later.
descriptions.forecast: Expected conversions and revenue from the leads open today.
descriptions.custom: Build your own report — pick the rows, columns and filters.
